description: This file defines React components and classes for channel mention suggestions in a chat application, including a React component for rendering individual suggestions and a provider class for managing channel mention autocomplete logic.

classes.name: ChannelMentionProvider
classes.description: A class that provides channel mention suggestions, handling user input, fetching channels, and managing suggestion groups.

methods.name: ChannelMentionSuggestion
methods.description: A React component that renders a suggestion item for a channel, including icon and name.

methods.name: setProps
methods.description: Sets properties for the provider, such as whether to delay channel autocomplete.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the pretext input, triggers channel search, and updates suggestion groups.

methods.name: handleCompleteWord
methods.description: Marks a word as completed in the suggestion process.
